notes.title: We're going to gamescom 2025!
notes.content: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]We're excited to announce that our team will be attending [url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]gamescom 2025[/url] as guests this year. [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to meet fellow developers, players, and fans — and to share more about our game in person.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to learn more about our first game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665310/Life_Souls/"]Life Souls[/url] — let’s connect![/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to message us here or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/ZWjQRgjyJH"]Discord [/url]if you’d like to meet up or chat during the event.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in Cologne![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665423/04f98d2c3d87de885d53ad3fc0493812065b511d.png"][/img][/p]
